description.value:
Always on (automated): +1 to Weapons and Intimidate checks.

Action (once per scene): spend your Action on this technique; your next Weapons and Intimidate check this scene gains a further +2.

Technique strike (automated): use the item to roll an attack (STR modifier) and 1d6 + STR modifier physical damage. Targets Defend or Dodge as normal.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
